name: LinkedIn Ads
description: Advertising platform: LinkedIn Marketing API for creating and managing ad campaigns, reporting, lead sync and company-page content.
access_notes: All Marketing/Advertising API access requires applying for the Advertising API product on a LinkedIn developer app tied to a verified Company Page; LinkedIn manually reviews every application against qualification criteria (established business, established use case) and 'reserves the right to review applications and select partners at its discretion'. Development tier (max 5 ad accounts for POST) is the entry point; Standard tier and restricted APIs (Matched Audiences, Audience Insights, Media Planning) require further review/forms with up to 60-day response times. Reviews commonly take weeks to months.
mcp_notes: Composio LINKEDIN_ADS toolkit exists (28 tools, OAuth2, no Composio-managed auth, so you must bring your own approved LinkedIn app credentials). No official LinkedIn/Microsoft vendor MCP for the Marketing API found in official docs.
uncertainty_notes: 2-legged client-credentials OAuth exists in LinkedIn's shared auth docs but most Marketing API permissions are 3-legged member-auth only. Exact review timelines are not published by LinkedIn (third-party sources report 4 weeks to 4 months).

evidence.note: Documents 3-legged OAuth (member authorization) and 2-legged OAuth (client credentials) as the two authorization flows for LinkedIn APIs
Step 1 is 'Apply for API Access': create a Company Page and developer app, then apply for the desired API under the Products tab and complete the access form

Development vs Standard access tiers; 'LinkedIn reserves the right to review applications and select partners at its discretion and a partner might not be upgraded even if they meet these minimum requirements'
Qualifications include an established business and established use case; restricted APIs are private and require additional approval via a separate form after Advertising API approval
Webhook registration/validation (HMAC-SHA256 challenge) for push notifications, e.g. lead notifications; Webhooks tab only enabled for apps with an approved webhook use case
Composio LINKEDIN_ADS toolkit: OAUTH2 auth, 28 tools (campaigns, analytics, lead forms), 'Composio Managed App Available? No'
